intro: End your day in effortless luxury with the Ray bed. A motorized lift reveals hidden storage, while soft LED light create a bedroom that feels calming, modern, and complete.

features.title: Motorized storage made effortless
features.text: Electro-mechanical lift-up lets you access underbed storage at the push of a button, making heavy mattresses easy to manage.

features.title: LED headboard for night comfort
features.text: A built-in LED strip illuminates softly, helping you read, wind down, or move around at night without disturbing your sleep.

features.title: Headboard storage within reach
features.text: Openable doors and open shelves keep books, glasses, and essentials close at hand, so your nights stay organized and restful.

features.title: Sleek finish with modern appeal
features.text: Sonoma Oak body with hi-gloss PU headboard in brown adds timeless elegance, blending durability with refined design.

features.title: Strong engineered wood build
features.text: Constructed from prelaminated particle board and MDF, the bed ensures strength and long-lasting reliability in daily use.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Ray Pro Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Led Headboard And Motorized Storage
